note: The Turks and Caicos Islands: only Turks and Caicos Islanders, permanent residents endorsed to work and Islanders' spouses work without a work permit; the employer applies, after advertising for an Islander where a labour clearance is needed. No days without it. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: Turks and Caicos Islands Government, Border Control and Employment, Work Permits
sources.said: The following persons can work in the Turks and Caicos Islands without a work permit. ... A Turks and Caicos Islander ... A work permit application should only be submitted if an employee/s is/are needed to perform a real job and all efforts to recruit a Turks and Caicos Islander has failed.
